description: Defines an enumeration 'TemplateType' with two possible values: DOCUMENT and SMS. It includes serialization annotations and methods to access the enum's id and name.

classes.name: TemplateType
classes.description: An enumeration representing different types of templates, with associated id and name, and serialization configurations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the template type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template type.
